copyright.en: The copyright notice appears at the foot of every page of the manuscript.
copyright.zh: 版权声明出现在手稿的每一页页脚。

copyright.en: Researchers must respect copyright when reproducing figures from published articles.
copyright.zh: 研究者在复制已发表文章中的图件时必须遵守版权规定。

copyright.en: Copyright law protects the original author against unauthorized use of the text.
copyright.zh: 版权法保护原作者免受文本被未经授权使用的侵害。

open science.en: Open science encourages researchers to share data and code as early as possible.
open science.zh: 开放科学鼓励研究者尽早共享数据与代码。

open science.en: The journal promotes open science by publishing peer review reports alongside each article.
open science.zh: 该期刊通过在每篇文章旁附上同行评审报告来推动开放科学。

open science.en: Open science has changed how laboratories collaborate across institutional borders.
open science.zh: 开放科学改变了各实验室跨越机构边界开展合作的方式。

open data.en: Governments release open data so that citizens can scrutinize how public money is spent.
open data.zh: 政府发布开放数据，以便公民监督公共资金的使用。

open data.en: The municipality built a portal where open data are downloaded in standard formats.
open data.zh: 该市府建立了一个门户网站，开放数据可在其中以标准格式下载。

open data.en: Researchers combined open data from several agencies to model regional air quality.
open data.zh: 研究者合并了多个机构的开放数据以对区域空气质量建模。

climate change.en: Climate change alters rainfall patterns and puts pressure on regional food systems.
climate change.zh: 气候变化改变降水模式，并给区域食物系统带来压力。

climate change.en: The report links climate change to the spread of vector-borne diseases.
climate change.zh: 该报告把气候变化与媒介传播疾病的扩散联系起来。

climate change.en: Emissions reductions are now central to national climate change policy.
climate change.zh: 减排已成为各国气候变化政策的核心。

land use.en: Land use change is the largest driver of biodiversity loss in the tropics.
land use.zh: 土地利用变化是热带地区生物多样性丧失的最大驱动因素。

land use.en: Remote sensing images allow planners to monitor land use across the whole province.
land use.zh: 遥感影像使规划者能够监测全省范围内的土地利用情况。

land use.en: Zoning rules restrict land use and development near the wetland.
land use.zh: 分区规定限制湿地附近的土地利用与开发。

public health.en: Public health authorities issued guidance on food safety during the outbreak.
public health.zh: 公共卫生主管部门在疫情暴发期间发布了食品安全指南。

public health.en: Clean water supply remains a cornerstone of public health in many regions.
public health.zh: 清洁供水仍是许多地区公共卫生的基石。

public health.en: The journal publishes evidence that can be applied directly in public health practice.
public health.zh: 该期刊发表可直接应用于公共卫生实践的证据。

health inequality.en: Health inequality between income groups widened over the study period.
health inequality.zh: 研究期间不同收入组之间的健康不平等有所扩大。

health inequality.en: Housing conditions contribute substantially to health inequality across neighborhoods.
health inequality.zh: 住房条件对不同社区之间的健康不平等有显著影响。

health inequality.en: The study quantifies how health inequality varies by education level.
health inequality.zh: 该研究量化了健康不平等如何随教育程度而变化。

life expectancy.en: Life expectancy at birth rose steadily across the twentieth century.
life expectancy.zh: 出生时的预期寿命在二十世纪稳步上升。

life expectancy.en: Regional disparities in life expectancy persist despite rising average incomes.
life expectancy.zh: 尽管平均收入上升，区域间的预期寿命差距依然存在。

life expectancy.en: Preventive care is expected to improve life expectancy in later decades.
life expectancy.zh: 预防性医疗有望在此后数十年提高预期寿命。

mental health.en: Mental health services were expanded to reduce waiting times for assessment.
mental health.zh: 心理健康服务得到扩充，以缩短评估的等待时间。

mental health.en: The survey links financial insecurity to poor mental health among younger workers.
mental health.zh: 该调查把经济不安全感与年轻劳动者的心理健康不佳联系起来。

mental health.en: Universities are expected to embed mental health support within ordinary academic routines.
mental health.zh: 高校应在日常教学安排中融入心理健康支持。

risk factor.en: Smoking is a major risk factor for cardiovascular disease in this population.
risk factor.zh: 吸烟是该人群心血管疾病的主要风险因素。

risk factor.en: The authors adjusted for known risk factors when estimating the effect.
risk factor.zh: 作者在估计效应时对已知风险因素进行了校正。

risk factor.en: Low birth weight was identified as an independent risk factor for later disability.
risk factor.zh: 低出生体重被认定为日后残疾的独立风险因素。

randomized controlled trial.en: A randomized controlled trial provides stronger evidence than an observational design.
randomized controlled trial.zh: 随机对照试验提供的证据强于观察性设计。

randomized controlled trial.en: Participants in the randomized controlled trial were randomly allocated to two groups.
randomized controlled trial.zh: 该随机对照试验的参与者被随机分配到两组。

randomized controlled trial.en: This conclusion rests on a single randomized controlled trial in a narrow population.
randomized controlled trial.zh: 该结论仅依赖一项研究对象范围较窄的随机对照试验。

numeracy.en: Numeracy skills shape how well students interpret statistical information.
numeracy.zh: 计算能力影响学生解读统计信息的能力。

numeracy.en: The intervention tested whether explicit teaching improves numeracy among adolescents.
numeracy.zh: 该干预措施检验了显式教学能否提升青少年的计算能力。

numeracy.en: Financial numeracy varies widely across adult populations in the survey.
numeracy.zh: 该调查中成年群体的金融数理素养差异很大。

instruction.en: Differentiated instruction improved outcomes for mixed-ability classes.
instruction.zh: 差异化教学改善了混合能力班级的学习效果。

instruction.en: Instructional time was limited by the availability of laboratory equipment.
instruction.zh: 实验设备的可用性限制了教学时间。

instruction.en: Teachers received training in how to structure instruction for large cohorts.
instruction.zh: 教师接受了如何为大型队列安排教学的培训。

scholarship.en: Her scholarship on early modern trade networks appeared in a leading journal.
scholarship.zh: 她关于近代早期贸易网络的研究发表于一份顶尖期刊。

scholarship.en: The book gathers scholarship from several disciplines on urban history.
scholarship.zh: 该书汇集了多个学科关于城市史的学术研究成果。

scholarship.en: That debate reshaped subsequent scholarship on colonial economies.
scholarship.zh: 那场辩论重塑了此后关于殖民地经济学的学术研究。

enrollment.en: Enrollment in the trial reached its target within six months.
enrollment.zh: 该试验的入组在六个月内达到了目标。

enrollment.en: Low enrollment rates limit the statistical power of the cohort study.
enrollment.zh: 入组率低限制了队列研究的统计效能。

enrollment.en: Enrollment at the college rose after the new scholarship program was introduced.
enrollment.zh: 新奖学金项目推出后，该学院的注册入学人数增加了。

engagement.en: Student engagement declined as class sizes increased.
engagement.zh: 随着班级规模扩大，学生参与度下降。

engagement.en: The review examines public engagement with the findings of the trial.
engagement.zh: 该综述考察了公众对试验结果的参与情况。

engagement.en: Sustained engagement from community partners shaped the design of the program.
engagement.zh: 社区伙伴的持续投入塑造了该项目的设计。

behavior.en: Sleep behavior was recorded by wearable devices over a two-week period.
behavior.zh: 睡眠行为通过可穿戴设备连续记录了两周。

behavior.en: Nudging can shift consumer behavior without any change in incentives.
behavior.zh: 助推手段可以在不改变激励的情况下改变消费者行为。

behavior.en: The intervention aimed to modify risky behavior among young drivers.
behavior.zh: 该干预措施旨在改变年轻驾驶员的高风险行为。

taxation.en: Progressive taxation reduces the after-tax income gap between households.
taxation.zh: 累进税制缩小了家庭之间的税后收入差距。

taxation.en: Taxation of carbon emissions shifted production toward cleaner technologies.
taxation.zh: 对碳排放征税促使生产转向更清洁的技术。

taxation.en: The model compares the revenue raised under alternative taxation schemes.
taxation.zh: 该模型比较了不同税收方案带来的财政收入。

cost-effectiveness.en: Cost-effectiveness analysis guided the decision to fund the program.
cost-effectiveness.zh: 成本效果分析为是否资助该项目提供了依据。

cost-effectiveness.en: The intervention was rejected because its cost-effectiveness was poor.
cost-effectiveness.zh: 该干预措施因成本效果不佳而被否决。

cost-effectiveness.en: A cost-effectiveness ratio alone cannot settle the ranking of interventions.
cost-effectiveness.zh: 仅凭成本效果比无法确定各干预措施的排序。

disincentive.en: High transaction costs act as a disincentive for small firms to invest.
disincentive.zh: 高额交易成本对小企业投资构成抑制因素。

disincentive.en: Removing the tax penalty eliminates the main disincentive to reporting errors.
disincentive.zh: 取消税务处罚消除了报告错误这一行为的主要抑制因素。

disincentive.en: The subsidy was reduced because it functioned as a disincentive to competition.
disincentive.zh: 该补贴被削减，因为它对竞争构成了抑制作用。

audit.en: An independent audit confirmed that the reported figures matched the source records.
audit.zh: 一项独立审计确认所报数据与源记录相符。

audit.en: The data audit revealed inconsistencies between two reporting systems.
audit.zh: 数据核查暴露出两个报告系统之间的不一致。

audit.en: A routine audit of laboratory procedures is carried out every year.
audit.zh: 实验室流程的例行审计每年进行一次。

supply chain.en: Disruptions in the supply chain delayed the delivery of raw materials.
supply chain.zh: 供应链中断延误了原材料的交付。

supply chain.en: The firm mapped its supply chain to identify single points of failure.
supply chain.zh: 该公司绘制了供应链图谱以识别单点故障。

supply chain.en: Rising energy prices put pressure on the whole supply chain.
supply chain.zh: 能源价格上涨给整个供应链带来压力。
